class MultilineContinuationError(ParsingError):
    """Raised when a valueless option has an indented continuation."""

    def __init__(self, source, lineno, line):
        Error.__init__(
            self,
            'Key without value continued with an indented line.\n'
            'source: %r, line: %d\n%r' % (source, lineno, line))
        self.source = source
        self.lineno = lineno
        self.line = line
